name: GOKUL DHAMODARAN
summary: Business and data analyst with 5+ years turning marketing and operations data into decisions for leadership teams across North America, Europe and APAC. Founder of Euliv Analytics, a live AI analytics platform I designed and delivered end to end: requirements, data modeling, testing and release. MBA candidate, Management Science & Quantitative Methods.

experience.title: Founder & Product Lead  Independent Project
bullets: Conceived and launched Euliv Analytics (working name GD360), a live AI analytics platform, as sole owner of product, data and delivery: idea to live production within 10 months with AI-assisted development (Python/FastAPI, React/TypeScript, PostgreSQL).
Wrote requirements, wireframes and acceptance criteria for 58+ release cycles, and verified each one with automated API and browser test suites before deploying.
Modeled a governed metric layer (shared metric definitions, row-level access rules, data-freshness checks) so every number in an answer traces back to its source query.

Integrated 20+ data sources, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, Google Sheets, GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads, HubSpot, Shopify and Stripe, through API/OAuth connectors and scheduled syncs.
Ran root-cause analysis on defects using logs and SQL, documented decisions in 130+ specs, and benchmarked Hex, Looker Studio, Metabase and Mode to define three-tier pricing.

experience.title: Marketing & Communications Graduate Assistant
bullets: Built Excel and Power BI dashboards tracking social, email and website engagement, and used the results to improve departmental outreach.
Supported 20+ graduate students in RapidMiner and applied analytics: data preparation, modeling and interpretation.

experience.title: Senior Analyst, Growth Marketing
bullets: Built Power BI and Google Analytics dashboards with SQL and Python to track ROAS, CPL, CTR and pipeline contribution; delivered weekly performance reports with optimization recommendations to senior leadership.

Analyzed account and persona data for an account-based marketing program covering 100+ enterprise accounts (HubSpot, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Apollo), contributing to a 35% increase in qualified pipeline.

experience.title: Digital Marketing Analyst
bullets: Ran A/B tests on creatives and audiences across Google Ads, LinkedIn and Meta, and adjusted bids and targeting from daily performance data.
Tracked organic performance in SEMrush and Google Analytics to guide keyword and on-page work, contributing to a 140% increase in digital impressions.

experience.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
bullets: Automated weekly reporting with SQL and Python into Power BI, Tableau and Excel dashboards, giving leadership and clients visibility into CPL, CTR, ROAS and lead quality.
Managed paid media for multiple B2B industrial brands and grew combined social following by 60%+.
